pages.title: hidebox: your private drive
pages.description: Your private cloud storage. Files lock in your browser first. You pick how each file opens: once, with a word, or for Tari.

pages.title: How hidebox works
pages.description: How hidebox keeps your files private: a key made in your browser, files locked before upload, and private Tari payments.

pages.title: Under the hood: how hidebox was made
pages.description: The grown-up page: your key, folders, pay to open, who sees what, space, receipts on the Tari chain, how to check us, and what we can't hide.

pages.title: hidebox for judges
pages.description: Two six-step tracks for the Tari Council: one device and no wallet, about two minutes; then two devices with Tari, about five minutes.

pages.title: The fine print · hidebox
pages.description: Privacy, terms and the form to report a link: what we keep, table by table, how long each thing lasts, and what you may not do with it.
